title: Research five-dimensional port decoder for P112
body:
## Result

Adds a five-dimensional port decoder construction for the selected 112 labels in `F2^9`. A seeded incidence search partitions the labels into 22 pairwise-orthogonal five-frames and one orthogonal pair. The 23 exact block matrices satisfy `I_9 = sum_g A_g M_g A_g^T`; their canonical rank-one factorization induces the full selected-port pairing matrix.

The 16 decoder terms have B14 support-pairing rank histogram `{7: 10, 8: 6}`, total copy charge 118. The package verifies all 161,280 five-frames, the full 112-by-112 decoder, 11,776 exact Gaussian-dyadic `C_E^2` address-basis cases, 672 dirty-input cases, one paired-plane positive control, and three corruption controls.

## Cost screen and limits

Replacing the selected eight rank-8 centre children gives local profile `{1:2412, 2:418, 3:432, 4:142, 5:82, 7:10, 8:6}` and mass 5,640. Under the changed `unpaid=5` law, the exact selected-word relaxation at `a=1/99` is `0.9774210973077914`; the certified ceiling is `0.017542237243537`.

The maximum aggregate rank-one-equivalent charge is 275, so 157 units remain after the copy invoice 118. There are 23 exact aggregate translations. If each is provisionally charged one unit, 134 units remain for all other source access, frame changes, routing, hosting, restoration and precision. That unit price is not a physical invoice. The native port contract, owner placement, frame schedule, full restoration and precision are not integrated. This is a local algebraic construction, not a supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier result.

## Reproduction

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/five-plane-port-p112-seed1f7fdfe4/verify.py
python3 research/five-plane-port-p112-seed1f7fdfe4/search.py --attempt-cap 10000
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/five-plane-port-p112-seed1f7fdfe4 --check-only
```

Direct verifier and search passed locally under Python 3.14.7; package metadata and input pins pass. Python 3.12 is unavailable locally (`python3.12` and `uv` are absent), so the registered Python 3.12 replay remains for hosted CI.

Base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`; selected-record SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`; catalogue revision 4 SHA-256 `d46eb6d5b3e279428753d770653663fbdf1063e55c255ea073d768f344927ef7`.

Predecessors: Discussion #1587 and merged PR #1825 (paired planes); Discussion #2024 / PR #2041 (three-plane P112); merged PR #1909 (tetrad-local E8-root supports, a different support object). Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review is claimed. Apache-2.0.
